description: A PostHog messaging template: reusable email content (subject, body, sender) that workflow email steps and the transactional email API send.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the message template belongs to.

Name.description: Human-readable template name shown in the template library.

Description.description: What the template is for and when to use it.

Tags.description: Tags for organizing templates, for example by team or use case. Tags are shared with the rest of the project.

Type.description: Message channel of the template. Currently only `email` (the PostHog default).

Content.description:
Template content keyed by channel, as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"templating": "liquid", "email": {"subject": "Welcome {{ person.properties.name }}", "text": "...", "html": "

...

", "preheader": "..."}}. `email.design` holds the visual editor's design JSON. Replaced as a whole on update.

MessageCategory.description: ID of the message category (PostHog::Workflows::MessageCategory) to file the template under. Must belong to the same project.

Sensitive.description: For emails that carry login codes, reset links or other secrets: PostHog keeps no copy of each sent email's body or filled-in subject, and clicked links keep only the site address.

TransactionalHogFlowId.description: ID of the workflow that sends this template over the transactional email API, once the template has been made transactional.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change.
